events.region: Coastal Collier County; Inland Collier County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 936 AM EDT, National Weather Service meteorologists were tracking
strong thunderstorms capable of producing a funnel cloud along a line
extending from near Golden Gate to Royal Palm Hammock. Movement was
north at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Funnel clouds and wind gusts of 45 to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Funnel clouds occasionally touch down and produce tornadoes
or waterspouts. Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and
blow around unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Golden Gate Estates, Belle Meade, Marco Island Airport, Orangetree,
Golden Gate, West Toll Gate On Alligator Alley, Big Corkscrew Island,
Royal Palm Hammock, Lely Resort, Corkscrew Swamp Sanctuary, South
Blocks Golde, Picayune Strand State Forest, Port Of The Island,
Intersection I-75 And Everglades Blvd, Fiddlers Creek, and Lake
Trafford.

morning.

9.1 feet on 06/28/2016.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWMAF

The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Brewster County in southwestern Texas...

* Until 945 AM CDT.

* At 831 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Panther Junction, Big Bend National Park, Chisos Basin, Study
Butte, Terlingua, Terlingua Ranch Lodge and Terlingua Ranch
Airport.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Coastal Waters from Mexico Beach to Apalachicola out 20 NM...
Coastal waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Mexico Beach out
20 NM...
Waters from Mexico Beach to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1015 AM EDT/915 AM CDT/.

* At 922 AM EDT/822 AM CDT/, a strong thunderstorm was located near
St George Island, moving west at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Apalachicola, Cape San Blas, Mexico Beach, St George Island, and
Port St. Joe.
